function.name: get_account_details
function.description: Retrieve backend account details for the configured account. Sensitive debt details must not be disclosed until verify_customer returns verified=true.

account_id.description: Customer account identifier, for example ACC-88392.

function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verify the speaker using the account ID and customer-provided last four PAN digits or birth year. This is the only tool that can authenticate the customer.

verification_code.description: Last four PAN digits or birth year. Mock valid values are 1234 and 1995.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Record a promise-to-pay after the customer is authenticated and agrees to a date and amount.

ptp_date.description: Promise-to-pay date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD where possible.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Send a mock payment link after authentication. This does not process payment.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Create a mock escalation for dispute, hardship, complex request, or customer-requested human support.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Log the final call disposition. Every call path must end with a disposition.
